description: Mark one website enquiry (lead_id from soclo_page_leads) dealt with, or put it back with handled:false. Free. Without confirm:true it returns a preview only; pass confirm:true only after the owner approves. A lost write reply must be reconciled with soclo_page_leads before retrying.

confirm.description: true only after the owner approved the exact change. Omit or pass false to get a preview: nothing is sent.

handled.description: true marks the enquiry dealt with (default); false puts it back.

lead_id.description: The exact enquiry id from soclo_page_leads.

name: soclo_page_lead_handled
title: Mark an enquiry handled
